---
title: "Representation and Electoral Systems"
---

::: lead-tagline
We tackle key questions in the fields of electoral systems and representation.
:::

Representation and Electoral Systems is a global community that promotes the research, teaching, and evaluation of electoral systems across various countries. We host events and build an infrastructure for exchanging ideas and supporting our collective scientific endeavors.

### About this website

This website was created and is currently maintained by [Yuki Atsusaka](https://atsusaka.org/)—inspired by ideas from [Erik S. Herron](https://vse-na-vybory.blogspot.com/). It is a collective project to revive and build on the [previous webpage](https://web.archive.org/web/20081202021347/http://apsa-res.blogspot.com/) maintained by Representation and Electoral Systems. Former newsletters are still available there. The previous website ceased to exist sometime between December 10th, 2016 (last confirmed ULR) and September 4th, 2017 according to the Wayback Machine.

This website is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/).
